name: bizplug-restaurants
description: The restaurants & food service plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: order ahead and takeaway. It works from the business's own published profile, covering menu, allergens, hours and reservation requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
